name: Asset Fetcher
description: Fetches external library files and hosts them locally, with SRI checking.
project_description:
This module downloads all external CSS & JS assets (e.g. from a CDN) and serves them from the site.

 Benefits 
 
 Comply to GDPR 
 Contrib module authors can just add CDN link, no download and local library detection needed 
 The downloaded library benefits from core or advagg aggregation 
 
 Note: This module plugs into the libraries system. So we can't help modules or themes that bypass this. They shouldn't anyway.
